text: Shimano Inc. is a Japanese manufacturer of bicycle components, fishing tackle and rowing equipment, head office in Sakai, Osaka, whose shares are listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
short: Shimano Inc. is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (Prime Market).
